steps.text: Waterfall of Life in view; 2 Token Vaults in reach with every token in its section
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Solo: choose a scenario card (p.20-21); first time, Scenario 1
steps.ref: Solo Mode

steps.text: Animal Refuge: pick a Base Animal set A-D (first game: A; solo: as the scenario says) and lay out its 8 cards; box the others
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5 / Lightning Mode

steps.text: Complete tokens and the End Game Bonus token near the Animal cards
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Shuffle the Terrain tiles (not the starting tiles) facedown; 3 faceup as the Terrain Tile Pool
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Seeds, Trees, Aquatic Flowers and Special Terrain tiles as the supply
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Insect and Scenery decks shuffled facedown, 3 faceup from each, room for each discard pile
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: A random starting Terrain tile in front of you (leave lots of room); box the rest
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Pick a colour: Resource Bag with 3 one-Currency, 2 two-Currency, 2 one-Leaf, 2 one-Water and 1 two-Fruit token
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Discard Pile Boat in your colour
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: 4 Player Markers on the leftmost space of the 4 Waterfall tracks
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Deal 2 Unique Animal cards, keep 1 faceup with its meeple on it (a Starting Seed icon gives 1 Seed); box the rest
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: The 3rd and 4th players get 1 Seed
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Draw 5 Resource tokens from your bag into your Play Area
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5

steps.text: Automa card with the scenario's side up
steps.ref: Solo Mode, Game Setup Changes

steps.text: A second Resource Bag with 8 Automa tokens, and its Discard Pile Boat
steps.ref: Solo Mode, Game Setup Changes

steps.text: In its colour: 1 marker on START of the Automa card, 1 each on the Tree and Flower tracks; box its other markers
steps.ref: Solo Mode, Game Setup Changes

steps.text: Do the scenario's Additional Setup, if any
steps.ref: Solo Mode, Scenarios

steps.text: Any 2 Resource tokens can pay as 1 resource of value 1
steps.ref: Rules Regarding Actions

steps.text: Overpaying gives no change, and one payment buys one type of Action
steps.ref: Rules Regarding Actions

steps.text: A new Terrain tile must touch your Jungle on at least 2 hexes
steps.ref: Place a Terrain Tile

steps.text: When 5 of the 8 Base Animal cards are used up, everyone else gets 1 more turn
steps.ref: Game Structure

steps.text: Lightning: before scoring, each player places 1 Tree, 1 Flower and 1 Special Terrain tile for free
steps.ref: Lightning Mode

steps.text: Solo: 20 turns; move Black Comet's marker after each Clean-up; lightning spaces draw an Automa token
steps.ref: Solo Mode, Gameplay Changes

steps.text: Whoever most recently watched a nature documentary goes first; play goes clockwise
steps.ref: Life of the Amazonia rulebook p.5
